package student

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type learningPathPlanningRepositoryStub struct {
	command domain.LearningPathPlanningCommand
	state   domain.LearningPathPlanningState
	err     error
}

func (stub *learningPathPlanningRepositoryStub) GetLearningPathPlanningState(
	context.Context, string, string,
) (domain.LearningPathPlanningState, error) {
	return stub.state, stub.err
}

func (stub *learningPathPlanningRepositoryStub) ApplyLearningPathPlanningCommand(
	_ context.Context,
	command domain.LearningPathPlanningCommand,
) (domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandResult, bool, error) {
	stub.command = command
	return domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandResult{
		Schema: domain.LearningPathCommandResultSchema, PlanningRequestID: command.PlanningRequestID,
		Command: command.Kind, State: stub.state,
	}, false, stub.err
}

func TestLearningPathPlanningReplanBuildsCanonicalExactPathCommand(t *testing.T) {
	repositoryStub := &learningPathPlanningRepositoryStub{}
	useCase := LearningPathPlanning{
		Paths: repositoryStub, Clock: onboardingClockStub{now: time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)},
	}
	_, err := useCase.Replan(context.Background(), LearningPathReplanInput{
		Schema: domain.LearningPathReplanRequestSchema, StudentID: journeyStudentID, LearningPathID: journeyPathID,
		PlanningRequestID: journeySnapshot, IdempotencyKey: journeyAssessID, CourseID: journeyCourseID,
		GoalCode: " GO.Backend ", CourseFingerprint: "fingerprint-v1", PlannerPolicyVersion: "planner-v2",
		ReasonCode: " REPLAN ", ReasonSummary: "Refresh route", ExpectedPathVersion: 3,
		DesiredItems: []domain.LearningPathItem{{
			ReferenceType: " LESSON ", ReferenceID: journeyLessonID, Position: 0,
			Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: " NEXT_GAP ",
		}},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("replan: %v", err)
	}
	command := repositoryStub.command
	if command.LearningPathID != journeyPathID || command.ExpectedPathVersion != 3 ||
		command.GoalCode != "go.backend" || command.DesiredItems[0].ReferenceType != "lesson" ||
		len(command.RequestHash) != 64 || command.RequestHash == "" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected exact-path command: %+v", command)
	}
}

func TestLearningPathPlanningRejectsMissingIdempotencyIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	_, err := (LearningPathPlanning{
		Paths: &learningPathPlanningRepositoryStub{}, Clock: onboardingClockStub{now: time.Now()},
	}).CompleteNoGap(context.Background(), LearningPathNoGapInput{
		Schema: domain.LearningPathNoGapRequestSchema, StudentID: journeyStudentID, LearningPathID: journeyPathID,
		PlanningRequestID: journeySnapshot, CourseID: journeyCourseID, GoalCode: "go.backend",
		CourseFingerprint: "fingerprint-v1", PlannerPolicyVersion: "planner-v2",
		ReasonCode: "mastery_no_gap", ReasonSummary: "Already mastered", ExpectedPathVersion: 1,
	})
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("expected validation error, got %v", err)
	}
}
